| [Project order](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Drafts the project order (PREQ) a steering committee sends to a project team, then prepares the kick-off, milestone reports and closure report. Use when a use case or system has passed its business case and needs a project order, when an initiative sheet has an empty sponsor, budget or out-of-scope field, when a kick-off is due, or when a milestone or closure report is needed. Writes the main target as a 30-second message, keeps the budget filled, names the requesting and contracting sides, classifies risks and lays out the procurement milestone chain for a bought solution. Also covers a customer-mandated program. Drafts only: sponsor approval, budget and sign-off stay human. Not for sizing the benefit (bc-build), the capital request (bc-capital-request) or who may approve (dept-decision-rights). |
